    "Lacked some advanced reporting or customization options",
    "Initial setup required adding tools one by one",
    "Notifications could sometimes be overwhelming"

  "overall_experience": "The Director of Operations likely found Basecamp to be a straightforward and effective tool for managing team communication and simplifying processes within their small marketing agency. Its user-friendly interface allowed for quick adoption, centralizing tasks and discussions efficiently. While appreciating its simplicity, they might have noticed limitations in advanced features for deeper operational insights or customization, and found the initial setup a bit manual."
